column2: Once in a lifetime, call down a Crisis War to break a colonial, slaving, or great hostile power. The target realm will be shattered if you win.

The time has come. [crisis_target.GetTitledFirstName] has proven themselves an enemy of balance itself: a blight no single kingdom can cure. I will proclaim a Crisis War against them. In two years, the war begins, and every great power must choose a side.
Sound the call: in two years, war
The Crisis War will begin in two years
The two years are past. Banners are raised, armies march, and envoys carry my call to every great power in the world. What follows will decide the fate of nations.
The Avatar has proclaimed a Crisis War against [crisis_target.GetTitledFirstName]. Every great power is asked to join the fight and help break them.
Sworn allies of the war leader for ten years. Answer their call to arms to fight in the Crisis War.
The Avatar has proclaimed a Crisis War against my realm. In two years they will come, and every great power that answers their call will come with them. I have that long to prepare.
